<!DOCTYPE doc SYSTEM "doc.dtd" [
  <!ELEMENT doc (head, (p | list)*)+>
  <!ELEMENT p (#PCDATA | em)*>
  <!ATTLIST p id ID #IMPLIED align (left|right) "left" kind NOTATION (gif) #FIXED "gif">
  <!ENTITY version "1.0">
  <!ENTITY % common SYSTEM "common.ent">
  %common;
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.gif" NDATA gif>
  <!NOTATION gif PUBLIC '-//W3C//NOTATION GIF//EN'>
]>
<doc>&version;</doc>
